{{Top|leg}}
The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] '''strike troops''' were created shortly before the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Their purpose was mainly infiltration, and prior to their deployment they trained for months aboard captured [[Yuuzhan Vong]] vessels. Three squads of strike troops participated in the [[Battle of Selvaris]], storming [[Peace Brigade]] ships to rescue high ranking Alliance prisoners.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

They wore [[Mimetic suit/Legends|mimetic]] [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suits]] and black helmets with tinted face bowls. Strike troops used a wide variety of armament, including [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash grenades]] and half-meter long [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]].<ref name="TUF" />
